title: Shopify orderUpdate recalculates taxes when an unfulfilled order's shipping address changes, as of 2026-10
summary: As of Admin API version 2026-10, changing the shipping address of an unfulfilled order with orderUpdate recalculates its taxes and totals against the new destination. Before, the tax lines were left unchanged.
migrationNote: After updating a shipping address, read the order's taxLines, totalTaxSet and totals again instead of assuming they are unchanged; reconcile any amounts your app stored.
